A policy takes the customer version valid at its start, a claim the

Every dimension has an 'Unknown' member with key -1, so a fact row
with a missing or invalid code still reaches the totals.
Earned premium by closed month and claim movements by date turn loss
ratio, frequency and severity into simple sums over any period.
